hero.title: EMAT Chile
hero.subtitle: Web Migration & Redesign Proposal
hero.description: A comprehensive digital transformation proposal to modernize EmatChile's online presence with cutting-edge technology and innovative design.

mainContent.quote: Modernizing the digital experience of EmatChile, ensuring optimized infrastructure, modern visual interface, and fluid navigation.

overview.title: Digital Transformation
overview.description: This project aims to perform the complete migration of EmatChile's website from Azure to Namecheap, along with a visual and functional redesign that reflects current standards in the energy industry.
overview.focus: The approach is oriented towards optimizing performance, UX/UI structure, and online shopping experience through custom development on WordPress, using best practices in frontend and backend development.

objective.title: Innovation & Sustainability
objective.description: To modernize the digital experience of EmatChile's website, ensuring optimized infrastructure, modern visual interface, and fluid navigation, with the purpose of transmitting the values of innovation, technology, and sustainability of the brand.

scope.title: Complete Web Solution
items: Complete website migration to new hosting (Namecheap)
Visual redesign of the main page (landing page)
Implementation of new templates for products and online store
Technical review, optimization, and final site validation

phase1.title: Landing Page Redesign
phase1.description: Creation of a new modern and adaptable visual design, aligned with brand values and sector references.
deliverables: Visual design in Figma (desktop and mobile)
New menu structure, hero section, CTAs and visual components
phase1.tools: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, UX/UI principles, mobile-first design

phase2.title: WordPress Update & Migration Prep
phase2.description: WordPress environment update to its latest version, plugin review, and database preparation for migration.
deliverables: WordPress updated and functional in staging environment
phase2.technologies: WordPress 6.x, PHP 8.x, MySQL, WP Migrate DB, Duplicator

phase3.title: New Landing Page Implementation
phase3.description: Development of the new main page based on the approved design, with optimized code and SEO best practices.
phase3.technologies: WordPress, PHP, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, ACF or Elementor

phase4.title: Complete Migration & Domain Change
phase4.description: Total site migration to Namecheap, DNS configuration, SSL certificates, and internal link verification.
phase4.technologies: Namecheap cPanel, SSL, DNS, WP migration tools

phase5.title: New Sections Design
phase5.description: Visual design of additional sections to be determined (product listings, individual views, etc.).

phase6.title: New Sections Implementation
phase6.description: Development and coding of the newly designed sections, integrated into the WordPress environment.
phase6.technologies: WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, WooCommerce, JavaScript

phase7.title: Final Validation & Optimization
phase7.description: Complete site review, usability testing, SEO optimization, and final performance tuning.

timeline.title: November - December 2025
timeline.description: Structured 7-phase development schedule ensuring quality delivery and milestone tracking.

budget.title: Total Budget
budget.timeDescription: Complete development timeline across all phases

finalNotes.title: Project Guarantees
notes: Budget includes design, development, migration, testing, and 2-week post-launch support
Does not include third-party premium plugin or theme licenses
Any new requirements outside the initial scope will be evaluated and quoted separately
Project will be executed under J-Studio supervision, guaranteeing quality, scalability, and visual coherence with EmatChile's identity

conclusion.title: Ready to Transform Your Digital Presence?
conclusion.description: Let's work together to create a modern, efficient, and scalable web solution that reflects EmatChile's innovation and leadership in the energy sector.
